race.title: Racing TV Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: WALK ON SON has fallen to an attractive mark and may just deny Lillistar a follow-up success. Two-time C&D winner Beat The Retreat also needs a close look in a competitive finale. WALK ON SON (IRE) LILLISTAR BEAT THE RETREAT (IRE)
